name: Seurat 核心分析
description: Seurat v5 标准分析: QC → SCTransform → PCA → UMAP → 聚类 → 注释
detailed_description: 基于Seurat v5的标准单细胞分析流程。支持SCTransform归一化(glmGamPoi)，PCA降维，UMAP可视化，Leiden/Louvain聚类，和半自动细胞类型注释。
when_to_use: 用户有scRNA-seq数据需要R/Seurt基础分析

proven_params.params: {"skill":"scrnaseq-seurat-core-analysis","method":"Seurat CellCycleScoring","gene_sets":"cc.genes.updated.2019 (S43+G2M54)","assay":"RNA (log-norm data)","unit_of_inference":"sample (n=48, 45 nuclei each)","tests":"Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon BH + Wilcoxon signed-rank paired + donor-level permutation (2000x) + 45-nuclei resampling bootstrap (500x)","ICC":"0.0175","design_effect":"1.76","effective_n":"1212","figures":"6 PNG(300dpi)+PDF"}
proven_params.result: MF_2000（2132 肌核/48 样本/6 组）细胞周期打分完成：相位 G1 43.8%/S 31.0%/G2M 25.2%。真实增殖标志物 MKI67 检出率 0.00%（全部核/组/供体）、CCNB1≤0.44%、CDK1≤0.37% → 终末分化肌核几乎无增殖细胞。组间比较：样本级 KW 仅 G2M.Score p=0.018（Pre 组 pct_G2M p=0.028），两两 Wilc
